propositions: Bedrock HTTP 400 ValidationException 'Grammar compilation timed out' occurs when rebar sends JSON Schemas with 22-36 optional parameters to Claude sonnet-4-6 for constrained decoding, exceeding Anthropic's documented 180-second compilation timeout and internal complexity limits.

Story 18ae commit 6c8daf7945 added native_structured_output=True for sonnet-4-6 in _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES, causing rebar to switch from PromptedOutput to NativeOutput for verification contracts that cannot be compiled, affecting both plan-review and code-review gates.

output_mode must gate NativeOutput selection on schema complexity by counting optional and union-type parameters recursively across $defs and nested properties, establishing a measured bound of 16 optional/12 union parameters to downgrade only the three failing contracts while preserving native output for smaller contracts.

Both schema-complexity (server-side 185s timeout) and botocore-variant (client-side 0s rejection of unknown parameter 'outputConfig') rejection shapes must be classified distinctly and trigger fallback to PromptedOutput rather than degrading all findings to no-verification.

The fix must be scoped to one output_mode construction site and one output_type call site in src/ to cover all execution channels (CLI, MCP, library, review bot) without introducing new subsystems or dependencies.
